versions.content: General validation of UDS requests according to ISO 14229-1 Status: DRAFT Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support the validation steps and order of the UDS requests according to figure 5 (General server response behaviour) and 6 (General server response behaviour for request messages with SubFunction parameter) of ISO 14229-1 including SID, Subfunction, minimum UDS request length, session permission and security checks. Rationale: – AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: – Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1
